source: Support Policy tables in the Laravel documentation: https://laravel.com/docs/12.x/releases (Laravel 10 to 13), https://laravel.com/docs/10.x/releases (Laravel 8 and 9) and https://laravel.com/docs/8.x/releases (Laravel 6 and 7). The PHP column gives the lowest and the highest PHP version a Laravel major supports.
note: Laravel 13 is listed by the 12.x documentation with its release as Q1 2026. Check these rows against laravel.com again before a release of lunaRun (PRD FR-PJ-07): a new Laravel major is one more row, with no code change.
